body:
```suggestion
	const String confirmation_message = TTR("As of Godot 4.4, scenes and resources use UIDs to reference scripts and shaders. This upgrade will be done on scenes and resources next time each is saved.\n\nTo save time, this tool can open and save each of these project files. Depending on the project size, it may take several minutes.");
```
Possibly something like this. Current wording seems slightly ambiguous. I'm not sure if it means that the whole project will be upgraded or just the specific files.

I asked an AI as I'm not a native English speaker and it gave me this short sentence (in bold).

> As of Godot 4.4, scenes and resources use UIDs to reference scripts and shaders. **Upgrades apply on the next individual save of each scene/resource.**

How is it?

> Upgrades apply on the next save of each individual scene/resource.

Seems fine, I'd prefer this so "individual" emphasizes the resource rather than the act of saving. Or even:

> Upgrades apply on the next save of each scene/resource.
Can we include a link to https://godotengine.org/article/uid-changes-coming-to-godot-4-4/ for details?
It doesn't accept links, I tried. i.e. it's not a RichTextLabel
